era: The 2017-2020 my.clevelandclinic.org design seen by every visitor in 2019 (no sign-in variant): grey utility row (800.223.2273, MyChart, Need help?, From out of town?, Giving, Careers, SEARCH), logo, plain nav (Find a Doctor, Locations & Directions, Patients & Visitors, Health Library, Institutes & Departments), grey breadcrumb band, large light headline, orange APPOINTMENTS & ACCESS and outlined CONTACT US buttons, white footer with Actions / About Cleveland Clinic / Site Information & Policies columns and a dark 'Call us at' band. Captures from 2019-01 to 2019-11 all agree.
